title: Characterizing Robustness in Semantic Code Clone Detection
abstract: arXiv:2606.25272v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Semantic code clone detection seeks to recognize shared functionality across different implementations, making robustness to behavior-preserving changes central to its effectiveness. Prior studies have exposed failures under such changes, motivating a systematic examination of how sensitivity varies with the rewrites used for evaluation. We present Systematic Code Transformation (SCT), a framework organizing 51 operators by code level, target, and edit category, and evaluate 14 token, tree, graph, and prompt-based detectors on BigCloneBench, Google Code Jam, and OJClone. By comparing transformation groups, repeated application, and alternative constructions, we connect overall performance changes with specific rewriting conditions. Of 25 token, tree, and graph detector and dataset combinations starting above 90% F1, 21 lose at least 10 percentage points under the composition of all operators. These losses vary with transformation typ

translated_title: 语义代码克隆检测中的鲁棒性表征
translated_abstract: 语义代码克隆检测旨在识别不同实现之间共享的功能，因此对行为保持型变更的鲁棒性是其有效性的核心。先前的研究已揭示了此类变更下的失败案例，这促使我们系统地研究检测器敏感性如何随评估所用的重写方式而变化。我们提出了系统化代码转换框架，该框架按代码层级、目标和编辑类别组织了51个转换算子，并在BigCloneBench、Google Code Jam和OJClone数据集上评估了14种基于token、树、图和提示的检测器。通过比较转换分组、重复应用以及替代构造方式，我们将整体性能变化与特定的重写条件联系起来。在初始F1分数超过90%的25个token、树和图检测器与数据集组合中，有21个在所有算子的组合作用下损失了至少10个百分点。这些损失随转换类型的不同而变化。
tldr: 该论文提出系统化代码转换（SCT）框架，通过51个按代码层级、目标和编辑类别组织的转换算子，系统评估了14种语义代码克隆检测器对行为保持型变更的鲁棒性，发现25个高性能检测器与数据集组合中有21个在全算子组合下F1分数至少下降10个百分点。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Systematic Code Transformation (SCT) framework, organizing 51 operators by code level, target, and edit category to systematically evaluate the robustness of 14 semantic code clone detectors, revealing that 21 of 25 high-performing detector-dataset combinations lose at least 10 F1 percentage points under the composition of all transformations.
